## Specification

### Component: Toggle, ToggleGroup, SegmentedControl

Three related controls in one family: a pressable `Toggle`, a `ToggleGroup` (formatting-toolbar style) and a `SegmentedControl` (radio-like with one gliding highlight).

#### Anatomy
```
<Toggle>                       button.ui-toggle [-outline] [-sm|-lg] [-icon], aria-pressed, data-state="on|off"
<ToggleGroup>                  div.ui-toggle-group role="group", data-variant, data-orientation
  <ToggleGroupItem />          button.ui-toggle (same classes), aria-pressed
<SegmentedControl>             div.ui-seg role="radiogroup", data-size, data-full, data-has-pill, data-ready
  span.ui-seg-pill             aria-hidden highlight, positioned with --ui-seg-x/-y/-w/-h
  <SegmentedControlItem />     button.ui-seg-item role="radio", aria-checked
```

#### Props
- `Toggle`: `pressed` / `defaultPressed` / `onPressedChange`, `variant` (`ghost` default | `outline`), `size` (`sm` 32 | `md` 36 | `lg` 44), `icon`.
- `ToggleGroup`: `type` (`single` default | `multiple`), `value` / `defaultValue` / `onValueChange` (`string` / `string[]`; `''` = none), `variant`, `size`, `disabled`, `orientation`. Items: `value`, `icon`, `disabled`.
- `SegmentedControl`: `value` / `defaultValue` / `onValueChange` (string), `size`, `fullWidth`, `disabled`, `name` (hidden input). Items: `value`, `disabled`.

#### Behaviour
- Toggle click flips `aria-pressed`. In a `single` group pressing the pressed item clears it.
- Roving tabindex: one tab stop per group (pressed/checked item, else first enabled). `ToggleGroup` arrows/Home/End move focus (useRovingFocus, loops). `SegmentedControl` arrows (all four) and Home/End move focus AND select.
- Segmented pill: measured from the checked item (`offsetLeft/Top/Width/Height`) into CSS variables; re-measured on every render and by a ResizeObserver. Not shown if nothing is selected. First render has no transition: `data-ready` is added one frame after mount.

#### Visual rules
- Toggle: 36px high, padding 12px, radius `--radius-md`, 14px/500. Pressed: `color-mix(in oklch, var(--ui-primary) 12%, transparent)` fill with `--ui-primary-text`. Hover (fine pointer): `--ui-accent`. Outline: 1px `--ui-border-strong`, `--ui-shadow-xs`; pressed border tinted toward primary.
- Outline group joins items (shared 1px borders, outer corners rounded); ghost group gap 2px.
- Segmented: well `--ui-surface-muted`, padding 3px, radius `--radius-lg`; item height 32 (sm 26, lg 40; 40/32/44 on touch), padding 14px, 14px/500, text 68% foreground → full foreground when checked; pill `--ui-surface-raised`, `--ui-shadow-sm` + 1px `--ui-border-subtle`, radius `--radius-lg − 3px`.

#### Motion
- Pill: `transform`, `width`, `height` over `--ui-spring-morph-duration` with `--ui-spring-morph`. Toggle press scale .97 (icon .94) on `--ui-spring-snappy`; colours 150ms. Reduced motion: pill jumps.

#### Accessibility
- Toggle / ToggleGroup: buttons with `aria-pressed`, group labelled via `aria-label`. SegmentedControl: WAI-ARIA radio group (`role="radiogroup"` / `radio`, `aria-checked`), icon-only items need `aria-label`.

#### Acceptance checks
- The pill's bounding box matches the active item's, and glides (does not jump) after a click, except on first render.
- Arrow keys in the segmented control change the selection; in a toggle group they only move focus.
- Multiple toggle group keeps several items pressed; tab order has one stop per group. No axe violations in light and dark.

### `ui/components/toggle-group/segmented-control.tsx`

```tsx
'use client';

import {
  createContext,
  forwardRef,
  useContext,
  useEffect,
  type ButtonHTMLAttributes,
  type HTMLAttributes,
} from 'react';
import { useControllableState } from '../../hooks/use-controllable-state';
import { useIsomorphicLayoutEffect } from '../../hooks/use-isomorphic-layout-effect';
import { useRovingFocus } from '../../hooks/use-roving-focus';
import { cn } from '../../lib/cn';
import { useComposedRefs } from '../../lib/compose-refs';
import { useTabStop } from './use-tab-stop';

interface SegCtx {
  value: string;
  select: (value: string) => void;
  disabled: boolean;
}
const Ctx = createContext<SegCtx | null>(null);

export interface SegmentedControlProps extends Omit<HTMLAttributes<HTMLDivElement>, 'defaultValue' | 'onChange'> {
  value?: string;
  defaultValue?: string;
  onValueChange?: (value: string) => void;
  /** Height: 32 / 36 / 44px. Default `md`. */
  size?: 'sm' | 'md' | 'lg';
  /** Stretch to the container; items share the width equally. */
  fullWidth?: boolean;
  disabled?: boolean;
  /** Submitted with a form (a hidden input carries the value). */
  name?: string;
}

/**
 * SegmentedControl — radio-like choice between a few views. One highlight pill
 * glides to the selected option (measured, CSS variables, morph spring).
 * Arrow keys move AND select (radiogroup).
 */
export const SegmentedControl = forwardRef<HTMLDivElement, SegmentedControlProps>(function SegmentedControl(
  { value, defaultValue = '', onValueChange, size = 'md', fullWidth, disabled = false, name, className, onKeyDown, onFocus, children, ...props },
  ref,
) {
  const [current, setCurrent] = useControllableState({ value, defaultValue, onChange: onValueChange });
  const stop = useTabStop('.ui-seg-item', '[aria-checked="true"]');
  const composedRef = useComposedRefs<HTMLDivElement>(ref, stop.ref);
  const roving = useRovingFocus({
    itemSelector: '.ui-seg-item',
    orientation: 'both',
    typeahead: false,
    onMove: (item) => item.click(),
  });

  // Put the pill on the selected item (CSS variables on the root)
  const measure = () => {
    const root = stop.ref.current;
    if (!root) return;
    const active = root.querySelector<HTMLElement>('.ui-seg-item[aria-checked="true"]');
    if (!active) {
      root.removeAttribute('data-has-pill');
      return;
    }
    root.style.setProperty('--ui-seg-x', `${active.offsetLeft}px`);
    root.style.setProperty('--ui-seg-y', `${active.offsetTop}px`);
    root.style.setProperty('--ui-seg-w', `${active.offsetWidth}px`);
    root.style.setProperty('--ui-seg-h', `${active.offsetHeight}px`);
    root.setAttribute('data-has-pill', '');
  };
  useIsomorphicLayoutEffect(measure);

  useEffect(() => {
    const root = stop.ref.current;
    if (!root) return;
    // Enable the glide only after the first position is painted: no animation on mount
    const raf = requestAnimationFrame(() => root.setAttribute('data-ready', ''));
    const ro = typeof ResizeObserver === 'undefined' ? null : new ResizeObserver(() => measure());
    ro?.observe(root);
    root.querySelectorAll('.ui-seg-item').forEach((el) => ro?.observe(el));
    return () => {
      cancelAnimationFrame(raf);
      ro?.disconnect();
    };
    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  }, [children]);

  return (
    <Ctx.Provider value={{ value: current, select: setCurrent, disabled }}>
      <div
        ref={composedRef}
        role="radiogroup"
        aria-disabled={disabled || undefined}
        className={cn('ui-seg', className)}
        data-size={size === 'md' ? undefined : size}
        data-full={fullWidth || undefined}
        onKeyDown={(e) => {
          onKeyDown?.(e);
          if (!e.defaultPrevented) roving(e);
        }}
        onFocus={(e) => {
          stop.onFocus(e);
          onFocus?.(e);
        }}
        {...props}
      >
        <span className="ui-seg-pill" aria-hidden="true" />
        {children}
        {name && <input type="hidden" name={name} value={current} />}
      </div>
    </Ctx.Provider>
  );
});

export interface SegmentedControlItemProps extends Omit<ButtonHTMLAttributes<HTMLButtonElement>, 'value'> {
  value: string;
}

export const SegmentedControlItem = forwardRef<HTMLButtonElement, SegmentedControlItemProps>(function SegmentedControlItem(
  { value, className, disabled, onClick, type, ...props },
  ref,
) {
  const ctx = useContext(Ctx);
  if (!ctx) throw new Error('SegmentedControlItem must be used inside <SegmentedControl>');
  const checked = ctx.value === value;
  return (
    <button
      ref={ref}
      type={type ?? 'button'}
      role="radio"
      aria-checked={checked}
      data-state={checked ? 'checked' : 'unchecked'}
      className={cn('ui-seg-item', className)}
      disabled={disabled || ctx.disabled}
      onClick={(e) => {
        onClick?.(e);
        if (!e.defaultPrevented) ctx.select(value);
      }}
      {...props}
    />
  );
});
```

### `ui/components/toggle-group/toggle-group.tsx`

```tsx
'use client';

import { createContext, forwardRef, useContext, type ButtonHTMLAttributes, type HTMLAttributes } from 'react';
import { useControllableState } from '../../hooks/use-controllable-state';
import { useRovingFocus } from '../../hooks/use-roving-focus';
import { cn } from '../../lib/cn';
import { useComposedRefs } from '../../lib/compose-refs';
import { toggleClassName, type ToggleSize, type ToggleVariant } from './toggle';
import { useTabStop } from './use-tab-stop';

interface GroupContext {
  isOn: (value: string) => boolean;
  toggle: (value: string) => void;
  variant: ToggleVariant;
  size: ToggleSize;
  disabled: boolean;
}
const Ctx = createContext<GroupContext | null>(null);

interface ToggleGroupBase extends Omit<HTMLAttributes<HTMLDivElement>, 'defaultValue' | 'onChange'> {
  variant?: ToggleVariant;
  size?: ToggleSize;
  disabled?: boolean;
  /** Arrow keys move along this axis. Default `horizontal`. */
  orientation?: 'horizontal' | 'vertical';
}
export interface ToggleGroupSingleProps extends ToggleGroupBase {
  type?: 'single';
  /** The pressed item's value, or '' when none. */
  value?: string;
  defaultValue?: string;
  onValueChange?: (value: string) => void;
}
export interface ToggleGroupMultipleProps extends ToggleGroupBase {
  type: 'multiple';
  value?: string[];
  defaultValue?: string[];
  onValueChange?: (value: string[]) => void;
}
export type ToggleGroupProps = ToggleGroupSingleProps | ToggleGroupMultipleProps;

type Loose = ToggleGroupBase & {
  type?: 'single' | 'multiple';
  value?: string | string[];
  defaultValue?: string | string[];
  onValueChange?: (value: never) => void;
};

/**
 * ToggleGroup — a row of toggles, one pressed (`single`) or several (`multiple`).
 * One tab stop; arrow keys move focus between items (roving focus).
 */
export const ToggleGroup = forwardRef<HTMLDivElement, ToggleGroupProps>(function ToggleGroup(props, ref) {
  const {
    type = 'single',
    value,
    defaultValue,
    onValueChange,
    variant = 'ghost',
    size = 'md',
    disabled = false,
    orientation = 'horizontal',
    className,
    role = 'group',
    onKeyDown,
    onFocus,
    ...rest
  } = props as Loose;

  const multiple = type === 'multiple';
  const [current, setCurrent] = useControllableState<string | string[]>({
    value,
    defaultValue: defaultValue ?? (multiple ? [] : ''),
    onChange: onValueChange as ((v: string | string[]) => void) | undefined,
  });

  const stop = useTabStop('.ui-toggle', '[aria-pressed="true"]');
  const composedRef = useComposedRefs<HTMLDivElement>(ref, stop.ref);
  const roving = useRovingFocus({ itemSelector: '.ui-toggle', orientation, typeahead: false });

  const ctx: GroupContext = {
    isOn: (v) => (multiple ? (current as string[]).includes(v) : current === v),
    toggle: (v) => {
      if (multiple) {
        const list = current as string[];
        setCurrent(list.includes(v) ? list.filter((x) => x !== v) : [...list, v]);
      } else {
        setCurrent(current === v ? '' : v);
      }
    },
    variant,
    size,
    disabled,
  };

  return (
    <Ctx.Provider value={ctx}>
      <div
        ref={composedRef}
        role={role}
        className={cn('ui-toggle-group', className)}
        data-variant={variant}
        data-orientation={orientation}
        onKeyDown={(e) => {
          onKeyDown?.(e);
          if (!e.defaultPrevented) roving(e);
        }}
        onFocus={(e) => {
          stop.onFocus(e);
          onFocus?.(e);
        }}
        {...rest}
      />
    </Ctx.Provider>
  );
});

export interface ToggleGroupItemProps extends Omit<ButtonHTMLAttributes<HTMLButtonElement>, 'value'> {
  value: string;
  /** Square icon-only item. Give it an `aria-label`. */
  icon?: boolean;
}

export const ToggleGroupItem = forwardRef<HTMLButtonElement, ToggleGroupItemProps>(function ToggleGroupItem(
  { value, icon, className, disabled, onClick, type, ...props },
  ref,
) {
  const ctx = useContext(Ctx);
  if (!ctx) throw new Error('ToggleGroupItem must be used inside <ToggleGroup>');
  const on = ctx.isOn(value);
  return (
    <button
      ref={ref}
      type={type ?? 'button'}
      className={toggleClassName({ variant: ctx.variant, size: ctx.size, icon, className })}
      aria-pressed={on}
      data-state={on ? 'on' : 'off'}
      disabled={disabled || ctx.disabled}
      onClick={(e) => {
        onClick?.(e);
        if (!e.defaultPrevented) ctx.toggle(value);
      }}
      {...props}
    />
  );
});
```

### `ui/components/toggle-group/toggle.tsx`

```tsx
'use client';

import { forwardRef, type ButtonHTMLAttributes } from 'react';
import { useControllableState } from '../../hooks/use-controllable-state';
import { cn } from '../../lib/cn';

export type ToggleVariant = 'ghost' | 'outline';
export type ToggleSize = 'sm' | 'md' | 'lg';

export function toggleClassName({
  variant = 'ghost',
  size = 'md',
  icon = false,
  className,
}: { variant?: ToggleVariant; size?: ToggleSize; icon?: boolean; className?: string } = {}) {
  return cn(
    'ui-toggle',
    variant === 'outline' && 'ui-toggle-outline',
    size !== 'md' && `ui-toggle-${size}`,
    icon && 'ui-toggle-icon',
    className,
  );
}

export interface ToggleProps extends Omit<ButtonHTMLAttributes<HTMLButtonElement>, 'onChange'> {
  /** Pressed state (controlled). */
  pressed?: boolean;
  defaultPressed?: boolean;
  onPressedChange?: (pressed: boolean) => void;
  /** `ghost` is transparent until pressed; `outline` adds a border. Default `ghost`. */
  variant?: ToggleVariant;
  /** Height: 32 / 36 / 44px. Default `md`. */
  size?: ToggleSize;
  /** Square icon-only toggle. Give it an `aria-label`. */
  icon?: boolean;
}

/** Toggle — a button that stays pressed (`aria-pressed`), e.g. Bold, Mute, Pin. */
export const Toggle = forwardRef<HTMLButtonElement, ToggleProps>(function Toggle(
  { pressed, defaultPressed = false, onPressedChange, variant, size, icon, className, onClick, type, ...props },
  ref,
) {
  const [on, setOn] = useControllableState({ value: pressed, defaultValue: defaultPressed, onChange: onPressedChange });
  return (
    <button
      ref={ref}
      type={type ?? 'button'}
      className={toggleClassName({ variant, size, icon, className })}
      aria-pressed={on}
      data-state={on ? 'on' : 'off'}
      onClick={(e) => {
        onClick?.(e);
        if (!e.defaultPrevented) setOn(!on);
      }}
      {...props}
    />
  );
});
```

### `ui/components/toggle-group/use-tab-stop.ts`

```ts
'use client';

import { useCallback, useRef, type FocusEvent } from 'react';
import { useIsomorphicLayoutEffect } from '../../hooks/use-isomorphic-layout-effect';

const isOff = (el: HTMLElement) => el.hasAttribute('disabled') || el.getAttribute('aria-disabled') === 'true';

/**
 * Roving tabindex: exactly one item of the group is in the tab order.
 * The focused item wins, then the one matching `preferred` (pressed / checked),
 * then the first enabled item. Attach `ref` and `onFocus` to the group element.
 */
export function useTabStop<T extends HTMLElement = HTMLDivElement>(itemSelector: string, preferred: string) {
  const ref = useRef<T>(null);

  const apply = useCallback(
    (target?: HTMLElement | null) => {
      const root = ref.current;
      if (!root) return;
      const items = Array.from(root.querySelectorAll<HTMLElement>(itemSelector));
      const enabled = items.filter((el) => !isOff(el));
      const active = document.activeElement as HTMLElement | null;
      const stop =
        target ??
        enabled.find((el) => el === active) ??
        enabled.find((el) => el.matches(preferred)) ??
        enabled[0];
      for (const el of items) el.tabIndex = el === stop ? 0 : -1;
    },
    [itemSelector, preferred],
  );

  // Every render: pressed / checked / disabled may have changed
  useIsomorphicLayoutEffect(() => {
    apply();
  });

  const onFocus = useCallback(
    (e: FocusEvent<T>) => {
      const item = (e.target as HTMLElement).closest<HTMLElement>(itemSelector);
      if (item && !isOff(item)) apply(item);
    },
    [apply, itemSelector],
  );

  return { ref, onFocus };
}
```

### `ui/hooks/use-controllable-state.ts`

```ts
'use client';

import { useCallback, useRef, useState } from 'react';

/**
 * State that can be controlled (`value` + `onChange`) or uncontrolled
 * (`defaultValue`). Every stateful component uses this so the two modes
 * behave identically.
 */
export function useControllableState<T>({
  value,
  defaultValue,
  onChange,
}: {
  value?: T;
  defaultValue: T;
  onChange?: (value: T) => void;
}): [T, (next: T | ((prev: T) => T)) => void] {
  const [internal, setInternal] = useState<T>(defaultValue);
  const controlled = value !== undefined;
  const current = controlled ? (value as T) : internal;
  const currentRef = useRef(current);
  currentRef.current = current;
  const onChangeRef = useRef(onChange);
  onChangeRef.current = onChange;

  const setValue = useCallback(
    (next: T | ((prev: T) => T)) => {
      const resolved = typeof next === 'function' ? (next as (prev: T) => T)(currentRef.current) : next;
      if (Object.is(resolved, currentRef.current)) return;
      currentRef.current = resolved;
      if (!controlled) setInternal(resolved);
      onChangeRef.current?.(resolved);
    },
    [controlled],
  );

  return [current, setValue];
}
```

### `ui/hooks/use-roving-focus.ts`

```ts
'use client';

import { useCallback, useRef, type KeyboardEvent } from 'react';

export type Orientation = 'vertical' | 'horizontal' | 'both';

const isDisabled = (el: HTMLElement) =>
  el.hasAttribute('disabled') || el.getAttribute('aria-disabled') === 'true' || el.hasAttribute('data-disabled');

/**
 * Arrow-key focus movement across items inside a container, with Home/End
 * and typeahead. Spread the returned handler on the container:
 *   const onKeyDown = useRovingFocus({ itemSelector: '[role="menuitem"]' });
 *   <div role="menu" onKeyDown={onKeyDown}>…</div>
 */
export function useRovingFocus({
  itemSelector,
  orientation = 'vertical',
  loop = true,
  typeahead = true,
  onMove,
}: {
  itemSelector: string;
  orientation?: Orientation;
  loop?: boolean;
  typeahead?: boolean;
  onMove?: (item: HTMLElement) => void;
}) {
  const buffer = useRef('');
  const timer = useRef<ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | undefined>(undefined);

  return useCallback(
    (e: KeyboardEvent<HTMLElement>) => {
      const items = Array.from(e.currentTarget.querySelectorAll<HTMLElement>(itemSelector)).filter(
        (el) => !isDisabled(el) && el.getClientRects().length > 0,
      );
      if (!items.length) return;
      const active = document.activeElement as HTMLElement | null;
      const index = items.findIndex((el) => el === active || (active !== null && el.contains(active)));
      const go = (item: HTMLElement | undefined) => {
        if (!item) return;
        e.preventDefault();
        item.focus();
        onMove?.(item);
      };
      const step = (delta: number) => {
        if (index === -1) return items[delta > 0 ? 0 : items.length - 1];
        let next = index + delta;
        if (loop) next = (next + items.length) % items.length;
        else next = Math.max(0, Math.min(items.length - 1, next));
        return items[next];
      };
      const v = orientation !== 'horizontal';
      const h = orientation !== 'vertical';
      switch (e.key) {
        case 'ArrowDown':
          if (v) go(step(1));
          return;
        case 'ArrowUp':
          if (v) go(step(-1));
          return;
        case 'ArrowRight':
          if (h) go(step(1));
          return;
        case 'ArrowLeft':
          if (h) go(step(-1));
          return;
        case 'Home':
          go(items[0]);
          return;
        case 'End':
          go(items[items.length - 1]);
          return;
      }
      if (!typeahead || e.key.length !== 1 || e.ctrlKey || e.metaKey || e.altKey) return;
      if ((e.target as HTMLElement).matches('input, textarea')) return;
      clearTimeout(timer.current);
      buffer.current += e.key.toLowerCase();
      timer.current = setTimeout(() => {
        buffer.current = '';
      }, 500);
      go(items.find((el) => (el.textContent ?? '').trim().toLowerCase().startsWith(buffer.current)));
    },
    [itemSelector, orientation, loop, typeahead, onMove],
  );
}
```

### `ui/lib/cn.ts`

```ts
/**
 * Join class names, skipping falsy values.
 * No tailwind-merge needed: ui-* classes live in Tailwind's `components`
 * layer, so any utility passed in `className` already wins.
 */
export type ClassValue = string | number | false | null | undefined;

export function cn(...classes: ClassValue[]): string {
  let out = '';
  for (const c of classes) {
    if (!c) continue;
    out = out ? `${out} ${c}` : String(c);
  }
  return out;
}
```

### `ui/lib/compose-refs.ts`

```ts
import { useCallback, type Ref, type RefCallback } from 'react';

type PossibleRef<T> = Ref<T> | undefined;

function setRef<T>(ref: PossibleRef<T>, value: T | null) {
  if (typeof ref === 'function') ref(value);
  else if (ref) (ref as { current: T | null }).current = value;
}

/** Merge several refs into one callback ref. */
export function composeRefs<T>(...refs: PossibleRef<T>[]): RefCallback<T> {
  return (node) => {
    for (const ref of refs) setRef(ref, node);
  };
}

/** Memoised composeRefs for use inside components. */
export function useComposedRefs<T>(...refs: PossibleRef<T>[]): RefCallback<T> {
  // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  return useCallback(composeRefs(...refs), refs);
}
```

### `ui/styles/components/toggle-group.css`

```css
/* Toggle, ToggleGroup, SegmentedControl ------------------------------------
   .ui-toggle [+ -outline] [+ -sm|-lg] [+ -icon]      state: [aria-pressed="true"] / [data-state="on"]
   .ui-toggle-group [data-variant="outline"]           items joined into one bar
   .ui-seg > .ui-seg-pill + .ui-seg-item*              state: [aria-checked="true"]
     Pill position comes from --ui-seg-x/-y/-w/-h set by the component;
     [data-ready] turns the glide on (not on first render); [data-has-pill] shows it.
   ------------------------------------------------------------------------ */

@layer components {
  /* Toggle */
  .ui-toggle {
    --ui-toggle-on: color-mix(in oklch, var(--ui-primary) 12%, transparent);
    position: relative;
    display: inline-flex;
    flex-shrink: 0;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    gap: 0.5rem;
    height: 2.25rem;
    min-width: 2.25rem;
    padding-inline: 0.75rem;
    border: 1px solid transparent;
    border-radius: var(--radius-md);
    background-color: transparent;
    color: var(--ui-foreground);
    font-size: var(--text-base);
    line-height: 1;
    font-weight: 500;
    white-space: nowrap;
    cursor: pointer;
    user-select: none;
    outline: none;
    -webkit-tap-highlight-color: transparent;
    transition:
      background-color var(--ui-duration-fast) var(--ui-ease-standard),
      color var(--ui-duration-fast) var(--ui-ease-standard),
      border-color var(--ui-duration-fast) var(--ui-ease-standard),
      box-shadow var(--ui-duration-fast) var(--ui-ease-standard),
      transform var(--ui-spring-snappy-duration) var(--ui-spring-snappy);
  }
  .ui-toggle > svg { width: 1rem; height: 1rem; flex-shrink: 0; pointer-events: none; }
  .ui-toggle-sm { height: 2rem; min-width: 2rem; padding-inline: 0.625rem; font-size: var(--text-sm); }
  .ui-toggle-lg { height: 2.75rem; min-width: 2.75rem; padding-inline: 1rem; border-radius: var(--radius-lg); font-size: var(--text-md); }
  .ui-toggle-icon { padding-inline: 0; width: 2.25rem; }
  .ui-toggle-icon.ui-toggle-sm { width: 2rem; }
  .ui-toggle-icon.ui-toggle-lg { width: 2.75rem; }

  .ui-toggle-outline {
    border-color: var(--ui-border-strong);
    background-color: var(--ui-background);
    box-shadow: var(--ui-shadow-xs);
  }
  @media (hover: hover) and (pointer: fine) {
    .ui-toggle:hover:not(:disabled, [aria-pressed="true"]) { background-color: var(--ui-accent); color: var(--ui-accent-foreground); }
  }
  .ui-toggle:active:not(:disabled) { transform: scale(0.97); }
  .ui-toggle-icon:active:not(:disabled) { transform: scale(0.94); }
  .ui-toggle:focus-visible { box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklch, var(--ui-ring) 45%, transparent); z-index: 1; }

  .ui-toggle[aria-pressed="true"] { background-color: var(--ui-toggle-on); color: var(--ui-primary-text); }
  .ui-toggle-outline[aria-pressed="true"] { border-color: color-mix(in oklch, var(--ui-primary) 45%, var(--ui-border-strong)); }
  .ui-toggle:disabled { opacity: 0.5; cursor: not-allowed; }

  /* Group */
  .ui-toggle-group { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.125rem; max-width: 100%; }
  .ui-toggle-group[data-orientation="vertical"] { flex-direction: column; align-items: stretch; }
  .ui-toggle-group[data-variant="outline"] { gap: 0; }
  .ui-toggle-group[data-variant="outline"] > .ui-toggle { border-radius: 0; }
  .ui-toggle-group[data-variant="outline"] > .ui-toggle:first-child { border-start-start-radius: var(--radius-md); border-end-start-radius: var(--radius-md); }
  .ui-toggle-group[data-variant="outline"] > .ui-toggle:last-child { border-start-end-radius: var(--radius-md); border-end-end-radius: var(--radius-md); }
  .ui-toggle-group[data-variant="outline"]:not([data-orientation="vertical"]) > .ui-toggle + .ui-toggle { margin-inline-start: -1px; }
  .ui-toggle-group[data-variant="outline"][data-orientation="vertical"] > .ui-toggle + .ui-toggle { margin-top: -1px; }
  .ui-toggle-group[data-variant="outline"] > .ui-toggle[aria-pressed="true"] { z-index: 1; }

  /* Segmented control */
  .ui-seg {
    --ui-seg-h-item: 2rem;
    position: relative;
    isolation: isolate;
    display: inline-flex;
    align-items: stretch;
    max-width: 100%;
    padding: 3px;
    border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
    background-color: var(--ui-surface-muted);
  }
  .ui-seg[data-size="sm"] { --ui-seg-h-item: 1.625rem; }
  .ui-seg[data-size="lg"] { --ui-seg-h-item: 2.5rem; }
  .ui-seg[data-full] { display: flex; width: 100%; }
  .ui-seg[data-full] > .ui-seg-item { flex: 1 1 0; }

  .ui-seg-pill {
    position: absolute;
    z-index: 0;
    top: 0;
    left: 0;
    width: var(--ui-seg-w, 0);
    height: var(--ui-seg-h, 0);
    transform: translate(var(--ui-seg-x, 0), var(--ui-seg-y, 0));
    border-radius: calc(var(--radius-lg) - 3px);
    background-color: var(--ui-surface-raised);
    box-shadow: var(--ui-shadow-sm), 0 0 0 1px var(--ui-border-subtle);
    opacity: 0;
    pointer-events: none;
  }
  .ui-seg[data-has-pill] > .ui-seg-pill { opacity: 1; }
  .ui-seg[data-ready] > .ui-seg-pill {
    transition:
      transform var(--ui-spring-morph-duration) var(--ui-spring-morph),
      width var(--ui-spring-morph-duration) var(--ui-spring-morph),
      height var(--ui-spring-morph-duration) var(--ui-spring-morph),
      opacity var(--ui-duration-fast) var(--ui-ease-standard);
  }

  .ui-seg-item {
    position: relative;
    z-index: 1;
    display: inline-flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    gap: 0.375rem;
    height: var(--ui-seg-h-item);
    padding-inline: 0.875rem;
    border: 0;
    border-radius: calc(var(--radius-lg) - 3px);
    background: transparent;
    color: color-mix(in oklch, var(--ui-foreground) 68%, var(--ui-surface-muted));
    font-size: var(--text-base);
    line-height: 1;
    font-weight: 500;
    white-space: nowrap;
    cursor: pointer;
    user-select: none;
    outline: none;
    -webkit-tap-highlight-color: transparent;
    transition: color var(--ui-duration-fast) var(--ui-ease-standard), box-shadow var(--ui-duration-fast) var(--ui-ease-standard);
  }
  .ui-seg[data-size="sm"] .ui-seg-item { padding-inline: 0.625rem; font-size: var(--text-sm); }
  .ui-seg[data-size="lg"] .ui-seg-item { padding-inline: 1.125rem; font-size: var(--text-md); }
  .ui-seg-item > svg { width: 1rem; height: 1rem; flex-shrink: 0; pointer-events: none; }
  @media (hover: hover) and (pointer: fine) {
    .ui-seg-item:hover:not(:disabled, [aria-checked="true"]) { color: var(--ui-foreground); }
  }
  .ui-seg-item[aria-checked="true"] { color: var(--ui-foreground); }
  .ui-seg-item:focus-visible { box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklch, var(--ui-ring) 45%, transparent); }
  .ui-seg-item:disabled { opacity: 0.5; cursor: not-allowed; }
  @media (pointer: coarse) {
    .ui-seg { --ui-seg-h-item: 2.5rem; }
    .ui-seg[data-size="sm"] { --ui-seg-h-item: 2rem; }
    .ui-seg[data-size="lg"] { --ui-seg-h-item: 2.75rem; }
  }
}
```

## Usage

**Segmented control** — from the docs (`apps/docs/examples/toggle-group/segmented.tsx`), imports rewritten to `@/ui/...`:

```tsx
'use client';

import { useState } from 'react';
import { SegmentedControl, SegmentedControlItem } from '@/ui/components/toggle-group';

const prices = { monthly: '$24 / month', yearly: '$240 / year (save $48)' };

export default function SegmentedBilling() {
  const [plan, setPlan] = useState<'monthly' | 'yearly'>('monthly');

  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col items-center gap-3">
      <SegmentedControl value={plan} onValueChange={(v) => setPlan(v as 'monthly' | 'yearly')} aria-label="Billing period">
        <SegmentedControlItem value="monthly">Monthly</SegmentedControlItem>
        <SegmentedControlItem value="yearly">Yearly</SegmentedControlItem>
      </SegmentedControl>
      <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground" aria-live="polite">
        Team plan: {prices[plan]}
      </p>
    </div>
  );
}
```
